email_body:
Hi Kay,

I noticed Heir of Bitter Thorn is joining The Fae of Bitter Thorn series this year, and it is clear from your catalog that you have built a loyal world of strong heroines across several complete series.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author. Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

One option that may suit Heir of Bitter Thorn is a short cinematic trailer with a few promotional reels. If a trailer or reels for Heir of Bitter Thorn is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production. It is entirely optional and independent of the Spotlight.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit Heir of Bitter Thorn best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
